# Flare Vault

> Flare Vault is non-custodial software for Flare Mainnet (chain ID 14). Users connect their own wallet; the site never asks for or stores a recovery phrase or private key. It offers sending and receiving of FLR, FXRP, bridged USDT and NFTs, swaps through SparkDEX V3, and Legacy Vault, a smart contract for inheritance planning.

## Markdown for agents
Request any page above with the header `Accept: text/markdown` to receive a Markdown version, or add `.md` to the page name (for example https://www.flarevaultapp.xyz/about.md). Unknown paths return HTTP 404, as Markdown when `Accept: text/markdown` is sent and as JSON when `Accept: application/json` is sent or the path starts with `/api/`.

## Machine-readable description
- [OpenAPI](https://www.flarevaultapp.xyz/openapi.json): describes these read-only content endpoints. Flare Vault has no account or transaction API; on-chain actions happen through the user's wallet and the public Legacy Vault V2 contract.

## Key facts
- Network: Flare Mainnet (chain ID 14)
- Custody: non-custodial; all transactions are signed in the user's own wallet
- Live: wallet connection, balances, send and receive FLR, FXRP and bridged USDT, NFTs (ERC-721 and ERC-1155), Legacy Vault V2, and swaps through SparkDEX V3 (0.25% Flare Vault fee, taken from what you receive inside the same transaction)
- Launching soon: FXRP staking through Firelight stXRP
- Audit: no third-party audit published yet; the Legacy Vault source code is verified and public
